name: Yoru no Namae
source:
We were completely different, but back then we were both obsessed with the same thing in the same place... “The Name of the Night” is a text-based adventure game that explores the arcade music game culture of 2000 through the story of two girls' delicate emotions.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3737500/_/]Steam[/url]]
